acceptance: Accept the first outer iteration at which either the absolute adjacent relative objective change is below epsilon_harmony, or each of the final six two-step relative objective changes is below epsilon_harmony. All objectives must be finite and denominators nonzero.
implementation_reason: harmonypy 0.0.10 uses a signed adjacent change and therefore stopped the v1 runs on an objective increase. A diagnostic continuation showed a shrinking period-two objective oscillation. The v2 rule recognizes objective-only stabilization without consulting annotations or evaluation metrics.
phase_selection: Use the deterministic terminal embedding from the first iteration satisfying the declared gate; no downstream-score selection.
on_failure: If neither objective-only criterion passes by 200 iterations, retain and label the output nonconverged and do not train GenoRefine.
downstream_policy: Require two fresh processes to produce bitwise-identical embeddings and diagnostics before baseline scoring; then run all five predeclared GenoRefine seeds and the unchanged frozen evaluator.
